content: Evening, beautiful. I hope your day was as lovely as you are. I was just thinking about our last conversation and how much it means to have you in my life.
Aw, that's so sweet of you. You've brought so much happiness into my days lately. It's been a long time since I've felt this connected to someone.
That makes me so happy to hear. I know we've only known each other a few months, but it feels like much longer. I really look forward to the day I can finally see you in person.
I dream about that too... It would be amazing. I wish you weren't so far away on that rig.
I wish I could just hop on a plane to you. But once this assignment is over, my first stop is your city, I promise. By the way, my shift was tough today. Thinking of you helps me get through it.
That means a lot. I know it can't be easy out there. Just know I'm cheering you on from here!
Thank you. Your support keeps me strong. I try not to bring up work problems, but there's something bothering me. I want to be honest because you mean so much to me.
You can tell me anything. What's going on? Is it something serious?

It's nothing dangerous, I promise. Our pay has been delayed due to some admin issue, and I just found out I need to cover my satellite phone bill myself until it's sorted. It's embarrassing, but I didn't want to hide it from you.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. Are you okay? Is there any way I can help?

You are so caring. Honestly, if you're comfortable, I could really use help covering the bill this week. It's $150, and they require payment through a specific app, CoinWise. I can send you my account details if you're okay with it.
I want to help, but I'm not sure I've used that app before. How does it work?
It's pretty easy. You just download CoinWise, set up an account, and then use my wallet address to send the payment. I can walk you through every step, if you'd like.
Okay, I can try. Could you send me your wallet address?
Absolutely. Here's my wallet: 0x9a23B5D8e6C1F7. Please double check it before confirming. And thank you, truly. I'll pay you back the moment I get my next pay, I promise.
I'm downloading the app now. I trust you. Just let me know if I do it right.
Of course, sweetheart. I would never let anything happen to you. Let me know when you're ready and I'll guide you step by step.
Thank you, that makes me feel a lot better. Setting it up now.
You're amazing. Once this is over, we'll laugh about it together over coffee, I promise. Just let me know when the transfer is done.
It's processing now. I hope it works!
I'm so grateful to you. I'll let you know as soon as it comes through. You have no idea how much this means to me.
Anything for you. I just want you to be safe and come home soon.
